create_graph_runner: create an InternViTCudaGraphRunner instance wrapping a PyTorch vision encoder module
create_graph: create a CUDA graph for a given input tensor keyed by batch and sequence dimensions
run_cuda_graph: run a captured CUDA graph by copying input data and replaying the graph for inference
build_cu_seqlens: build contiguous sequence length buffer for variable-length token sequences in vision encoder
alloc_workspace: allocate attention workspace tensor sized by tokens, attention heads, and head dimension
